scope: Identidade, adapter de modelo, canal controlado, knowledge catalog, retenção, restore e operação sintética
summary: REM-19 a REM-26 foram executadas no escopo local controlado. Identity jti/replay/rotação, bloqueio de credenciais no adapter de modelo, entrega controlada sem rede, resolução de knowledge aprovado/revogado, retenção redigida, restore tenant-scoped append-only e trilhas de auditoria foram implementados e testados. O gate externo de identidade/provider/canal/fonte não foi conectado.
changes: Identity operator com jti obrigatório, replay bounded e rotação ativa/anterior.
Model adapter com bloqueio pré/pós-redaction de credenciais e ControlledDeliveryAdapter sem egress.
Knowledge catalog resolvido no Test Lab, runtime publicado, worker, capability e API.
Retention ledger e restore redigem payloads, conferem tenant/ownership e preservam auditoria/checkpoints append-only.

full_suite.result: 148 arquivos passaram; 3 foram omitidos; 634 testes passaram; 23 foram omitidos

acceptance.REM-19: PASS controlled: contracts and external gate separation recorded; no credentials in docs.
acceptance.REM-20: PASS controlled: self-asserted headers rejected; replay/rotation and tenant/role boundaries tested.
acceptance.REM-21: PASS controlled: local adapter timeout/error/output secret boundaries tested; model never grants permission.
acceptance.REM-22: PASS controlled: delivery adapter is local, idempotent and no-network; takeover and retry journal are observable.
acceptance.REM-23: PASS controlled: approved version resolver is wired through API/Test Lab/runtime/worker; missing/revoked source hands off.
acceptance.REM-24: PASS controlled: redacted bounded retention, counters and append-only audit preservation.
acceptance.REM-25: PASS controlled: snapshot digest, ownership, cross-tenant rejection and redacted restore verified.
acceptance.REM-26: PASS controlled: local integration audit distinguishes mock/local from external readiness.

independent_critics.finding: Fresh-context read-only review confirmed the corrected identity, model, delivery, catalog, retention and restore boundaries with no P0/P1/P2 in local scope.
independent_critics.limitations: External IdP/provider/channel/source owner and HA/RPO/RTO approvals remain unconnected.

next: Run the controlled qualification dossier; obtain human/external gates separately before any pilot decision.
